item.title: Government considers restrictions on smart glasses over secret filming
item.body: Safeguarding minister Satvir Kaur told the Commons the government is considering restrictions on smart glasses amid concerns they are being used to film women secretly. She hinted at a restriction on selling the technology “to certain users”.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚫 Government considers restrictions on smart glasses over secret filming

Safeguarding minister Satvir Kaur told the Commons the government is considering restrictions on smart glasses amid concerns they are being used to film women secretly. She hinted at a restriction on selling the technology “to certain users”.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 21:33
